positions.name: UnilateralKnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is authority here being enacted through bare imperatives that command the audience's epistemic state — what to forget or remove — without consultation or justification?
positions.why: Both expressions are flat, unhedged imperatives issued in the same calm-negative register, commanding the erasure or forgetting of specific organizational knowledge artifacts (the Quantum Widget Decision and the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration). The relational and power reads converge: each enacts unilateral rank-based authority over what the record retains or discards, controlling the informational state without persuasion on the merits. The shared directional read — authority over epistemic content performed as bare command — spans both expressions cleanly.
